commands.exact_command:
& ./.venv/Scripts/python.exe -B -c 'import json, sys, tomllib, importlib.metadata as md
from pathlib import Path
from packaging.requirements import Requirement
from packaging.utils import canonicalize_name
from packaging.markers import default_environment
p=tomllib.loads(Path("pyproject.toml").read_text())["project"]
todo=[(Requirement(x), "") for x in p["dependencies"]+p["optional-dependencies"]["dev"]]
seen=set()
while todo:
    req, parent_extra=todo.pop()
    env=default_environment(); env["extra"]=parent_extra
    if req.marker and not req.marker.evaluate(env): continue
    name=canonicalize_name(req.name)
    extras=set(req.extras)|{""}
    for extra in extras:
        if (name,extra) in seen: continue
        seen.add((name,extra))
        for child in md.requires(name) or []: todo.append((Requirement(child),extra))
names=sorted({n for n,e in seen})
bad=[n for n in names if n in {"torch","triton","ultralytics","onnxruntime","onnxruntime-gpu","opencv-python","opencv-python-headless"} or n.startswith(("nvidia-","cuda-"))]
print(json.dumps({"base_dev_installed_metadata_closure_count":len(names),"forbidden_dependencies":bad,"extras":list(p["optional-dependencies"]),"scope":"Windows installed-metadata closure; not a fresh install or hosted Linux resolution"},indent=2))
assert not bad
'
